::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Slides.** [Open the slides at the menu](../../slides/full.html#/the-specification-menu){target="_blank"}, in Part 3, in their own tab, or follow them on the [slides page](slides.qmd).
:::

The fourth stage works the menu of the case study, fourteen decisions and a curve of 864 specifications, and ends with the case-study report and the choice of your project. It takes about six and a half hours.

## 1. The specification menu and the decision map

[Open the specification menu](../../menu.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the decision map](../../menu.qmd#map){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Read the menu, and select options on its decision map to find out what each option does to the estimand statement and to the results.

## 2. Task 4 – The menu

**On the slides, then in your report**, Task 4 of `index.qmd` or of `working_script.R`, with the browser lab standing in if your installation fails.

[Open the browser lab at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-explore){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Read the slides of Part 3 from the menu onwards. Then work through Task 4, from the chunk `try-baseline` to the chunk `submit-exploration`, and send the try that you would defend with `submit_exploration()` if you want it on the [class chart](../../class-results.qmd).

## 3. Multiverse and preregistration

**On the slides.** Read [Part 4](../../slides/full.html#/part-4-multiverse-and-preregistration){target="_blank"}. The class chart to which its slides refer holds the results of earlier cohorts.

## 4. Task 5 – Preregistration

**In the preregistration block of your report**, the chunk `prereg` of `index.qmd`.

[Open the browser lab at Task 5](../../lab.qmd#task-5-my-preregistration){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Complete the block before you run anything, and run it. Then go on to the chunks `build-model`, `run-spec` and `report`, and send your result with `report_result()` if you want it on the chart.

## 5. Within and between, and few clusters on the curve

[Open Within and between](../../companion/panel-data.qmd#sec-re){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [Within and between](../../companion/panel-data.qmd#sec-re), and then [Standard errors with few clusters](../../companion/panel-data.qmd#sec-inference) again with the curve in mind, since the CR2 correction with its Satterthwaite degrees of freedom classes every point of the curve: under that rule the reproduced specification has a p of 0.0504 on 9.8 degrees of freedom, against a conventional p of 0.0002. Write a sentence on what the CR2 test by country changes for the reproduced specification.

## 6. Reading a specification curve

[Open Inference on the curve](../../curve.qmd#inference){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the section Inference on the curve of the Specification curve page.

## 7. The multiverse and its critics

[Open The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-origins){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [Origins](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-origins) to [The Europeanisation curve](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-europeanisation).

## 8. Respondents who mention nothing

[Open Respondents who mention nothing](../../companion/measurement.qmd#sec-noop){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the last two sections of the module on scale construction.

## 9. The case-study report {#the-case-report}

**In your workspace.** Render the report with all five tasks complete, the preregistration as it stood before the run and the result beneath it. This is your case-study report.

## 10. The choice of a project

[Read the projects](stage-5.qmd#the-projects){.btn .btn-primary}

Read the list of projects on the page of stage 5, and choose one question beyond the claim.

## 11. A further module (optional)

[Scale construction](../../companion/measurement.qmd), on the battery of items from which the outcomes of the case study are built, supports a project on this case study.

**Shortcuts.** If stage 3 left fixed effects and few clusters clear, skip the second reading of the section on standard errors with few clusters and read only [Within and between](../../companion/panel-data.qmd#sec-re). If time is short, read only [Robustness and replicability](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-replicability) and [The Europeanisation curve](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-europeanisation) in the multiverse module now, and come back to the rest of it when your project in stage 5 needs it.
